summary: Closure review: authors addressed most prior requests (provider_call_audit clarification; disclosure of unexecuted templated comparator; model-generation settings). One required item remains: the manuscript lacks a concise in‑paper table listing the four repaired/discordant pair IDs with verifier violation codes, short human‑readable descriptions, repair invocation and model‑call counts, and direct artifact citations/SHAs. Resolve that and the paper will meet finalisation requirements.
critical_issues: Manuscript does not include the concise in‑manuscript table enumerating the four discordant/repaired pair IDs (pair-000090, pair-000341, pair-000381, pair-000413), their verifier violation codes with short descriptions, whether a repair was invoked, and per‑pair model‑call counts; readers must not be forced to parse raw JSONL to see these facts.
required_revisions: Insert a small in‑manuscript table (≤1 table) listing the four repaired/discordant pairs (pair-000090, pair-000341, pair-000381, pair-000413). For each pair include: verifier violation code(s) and a one‑line human‑readable description, repair invoked (yes/no), model calls used for the pair, and final score (pass/fail). Cite the archived per‑episode artifacts used to populate the table (e.g., execution/scoring/*.json and execution/raw_results.jsonl) and include their SHA‑256 hashes (the artifacts and hashes are available in the evidence bundle).
optional_revisions: Cite the verifier human‑readable codebook artifact path and SHA for the violation‑code → description mapping inline in Methods.
Add a one‑sentence table or sentence summarizing task difficulty buckets (terminal_factual_accounting difficulty_summary) in Results to aid external‑validity assessment.
Briefly note why the two‑sided conditional exact McNemar was chosen (one sentence) and why the bootstrap CI is reported only as exploratory.
